states.name: Initial Empty System
states.description: Scene loaded with bath and pipe routes visible, no gears placed, all flow rates at zero

states.name: First Gears Placed
states.description: User has placed 2-3 gears on different pipe routes, teeth engagement starting

states.name: Partial Configuration
states.description: 4-6 gears placed across routes, some flow rates active but system not balanced

states.name: Near Capacity
states.description: 7-8 gears placed, total teeth engagement approaching 24, flows adjusting

states.name: Balanced System
states.description: Exactly 24 teeth engaged, all three routes have proper flow, system balanced

states.name: Optimal Operation
states.description: Balanced system with gears rotating, water temperature and pressure in target ranges
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.systemBalanced === true && window.__3D_STATE__.gearsRotating === true && window.__3D_STATE__.waterTemperature >= 15 && window.__3D_STATE__.waterTemperature <= 45 && window.__3D_STATE__.waterPressure >= 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.waterPressure <= 100

states.name: Stable Long-term
states.description: System maintains balanced operation for extended period with consistent metrics

postconditions: At least 2 gears are placed on pipe routes
gearsPlaced counter has increased from 0
Gear models are visible in the scene

action.code: const slots = document.querySelectorAll('.gear-slot'); [5, 7, 9].forEach((idx, i) => setTimeout(() => slots[idx]?.click(), i * 700));

postconditions: 4-6 gears are now placed across multiple pipe routes
Total teeth engagement is increasing
At least two different pipe routes have gears

action.code: const slots = document.querySelectorAll('.gear-slot'); setTimeout(() => slots[11]?.click(), 500); setTimeout(() => slots[13]?.click(), 1200);

postconditions: 7-8 gears are placed (near maximum capacity)
Total teeth engagement is close to 24
All three pipe routes have at least one gear

action.code: const gears = document.querySelectorAll('.placed-gear'); if(gears[2]) { gears[2].dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', {deltaY: -100})); } setTimeout(() => { if(gears[5]) gears[5].dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', {deltaY: 100})); }, 800);

postconditions: Gear sizes adjusted to achieve exactly 24 teeth engagement
System is now balanced with proper conservation law satisfied
systemBalanced flag is true
Gears are rotating and meshing properly
Flow rates are active on all three routes
Water temperature and pressure are in valid ranges

action.code: const gear = document.querySelectorAll('.placed-gear')[0]; if(gear) { const startX = gear.getBoundingClientRect().left + 10; const startY = gear.getBoundingClientRect().top + 10; gear.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: startX, clientY: startY, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: startX + 30, clientY: startY, bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {bubbles: true})), 300); }, 200); }

postconditions: Gear rotation adjusted but system remains balanced
All flow rates still active
System metrics remain stable
System maintains balanced state over time
All metrics remain stable and within valid ranges
Gears continue rotating smoothly
System remains stable for 60 seconds
All state values remain valid and consistent
